text:
alice: heads up — deploybot blocked the canary for service-web. build pipeline reused tag `staging-rc` and the attestation digest doesn't match the pushed manifest. canary didn’t get promoted.

deploy-bot: [deploybot] publish rejected for `gcr.io/redwood/service-web:staging-rc` — provenance attestation digest != image manifest digest. full log: `attestation=sha256:aaa... expected=sha256:bbb...`

ben: ugh, tag reuse again. looks like the older build with the same tag got re-pushed. is this from the parallel CI run?

carla: CI shows job #5842 retried and re-used the tag instead of creating a new `staging-rc-<build>` tag. pipeline bug.

alice: decision needed: pin deployments to digest to avoid accidental pull of wrong image, or force a republish with a fresh tag + new attestation.

dave: pinning to digest is safest short-term. we can patch the canary svc to digest: `kubectl set image deploy/service-web service-web=gcr.io/redwood/service-web@sha256:bbb... --namespace=staging`

ben: +1 for pin now. afterwards we should retag and re-publish. also disable auto-promote in deploybot for this image until we confirm CI fix.

carla: I'll open a quick fix PR for the CI to always append `-ci<run>` to `staging-rc` tags so retries won't collide.

alice: plan: 1) pin canary to the known-good digest (dave) 2) republish a fresh image with `staging-rc-5843` and let deploybot re-run attestations (carla) 3) temporarily turn off auto-promote for the service (ben) 4) add release note + change window tonight 20:00 UTC (alice)

repo-sync-bot: mirror job queued: will attempt to push newly tagged images to eu-gcr region after publish.

ben: small ops note — when republishing, make sure to include `--attest-key=release-key` in the build step, otherwise repo-sync will still reject.

carla: ack, adding attest key. republishing now. build logs: `PUSH gcr.io/redwood/service-web:staging-rc-5843 -> digest sha256:ccc...`

deploy-bot: [deploybot] new attestation verified for `staging-rc-5843`. canary allowed but auto-promote currently OFF for this image.

alice: canary patched to digest and new tag deployed to canary. holding for smoke test. change window scheduled 20:00 UTC in #release-calendar.

dave: smoke tests green. ready for rollout when change window opens.

ben: I'll flip auto-promote back on after one successful rollout, and file the CI tag fix for immediate merge. :thumbsup:

alice: thanks all — follow-up: update release notes with the incident summary and the remediation steps (pin-to-digest, republish, CI tag fix). I'll own the notes. :white_check_mark:
